Hi Arielle — thanks for the RFP and timeline. High level first pass below; we'll follow with a formal quote by end of week.

1) Pricing scenarios (summary):
- 12-month committed: platform fee applied monthly, 15% discount on committed GPU units, standard support included.
- 36-month amortized: platform fee can be amortized across term; applies as a single line item with a 22% effective discount on unit pricing when paired with a 3-year commitment.
- Flex (no commit): higher platform fee, pay-as-you-go for capacity with metered pricing.

2) SME on-call: we offer a 40-hour migration block for $18,000 (Standard SME) or a Premium on-call (SRE + Architect) 80-hour block for $42,000 which includes 24/7 escalation during the two-week go-live.

To make the scenarios concrete we need your expected average token/day and planned concurrency across the first 12 months (your RFP has peak info, but typical utilization matters for batch vs. real-time sizing).

Attaching a short scenarios PDF that maps unit economics by commit term.

Next steps: Ben and Marissa will put together a matrix that maps to procurement line items (SOW, platform fee amortization, support SKU).

Cheers,

Arielle / Procurement team — quick commercial proposal to help with modeling:

Option A (12-month commit):
- Platform fee invoiced monthly.
- 15% discount on committed capacity.
- One-time migration credit: 5% of first-year platform fee applied as invoice credit.

Option B (36-month amortized):
- Platform fee amortized monthly across 36 months with a single SOW; 12% lower effective platform fee vs Option A.
- 10% migration credit (one-time) on the first invoice.
- Option to add a 12-month named SME on-call at discounted rate (30% off list) if purchased with commit.

We can also include an optional SLA addendum for Platinum support (1h response) for an additional fixed fee to make procurement's TCO more predictable.
